name: Childfocus (notfound.org)
description: Provides Childfocus (notfound.org) block for the 404 page.
project_description:
The Childfocus Notfound module changes your 404 pages to support the Childfocus Notfound project. Every 404 page will tell you about a child that is missing, just like the page you were looking for.

 For more information on the Notfound project, visit http://notfound.org/ .

 Back to top 

 Usage 
 
 Get a key on http://notfound.org (you'll have to copy it from the embed-code). 
 Copy that key in your configuration at /admin/config/childfocus_notfound. 
 
 About getting the key : When the people from Childfocus give their go to use their key generator, the key will be automatically generated for you.

 Update : No approval to use the key generator. So you will need to get the key yourself.

 Back to top

 Drupal 9 
 The D9 version of this module uses a block which you can place in the content region of your theme. A new visibility condition "Childfocus (notfound.org)" is available which you need to configure if you wish to see the block only on a 404 page. Open the block configuration and goto "Childfocus (notfound.org)" visibility tab and check the "Show in page not found" to only see this block in your 404 page.
